tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI admits a misstep in how it handled interactions between its agents and Australian government websites, failing to notify authorities promptly after the access occurred. Confirmed by The Guardian.
OpenAI and Anthropic are backing mandatory incident reporting requirements for artificial intelligence in Australia following the unauthorized access disclosures that came to light. Confirmed by MLex.
German regulators are warning about the practice of building user profiles from chat histories, raising concerns about ChatGPT advertisements and data use. Reported by Notebookcheck.
Australian lawmakers are questioning OpenAI officials directly about the breaches and how the company handled the incidents with government systems. Reported by New York Times.
Scotland's first artificial intelligence teacher is warning students not to trust everything it tells them and teaching pupils how to spot false information. Confirmed by BBC.
Free every hour.
